stories.title: Yesilgöz wil bij volgende verkiezingen weer VVD-lijsttrekker worden

en.title: Yesilgöz wants to be VVD lead candidate again in next election
en.summary: Dutch VVD party leader Yesilgöz has expressed her intention to lead the party's ticket in the upcoming elections.

stories.title: Rusland gaat diesel leveren aan VS en wereldmarkt, meldt Trump

en.title: Russia to supply diesel to US and global market, Trump reports
en.summary: President Trump announced that Russia will immediately supply 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global markets, with additional shipments planned for later months.

stories.title: Yesilgöz ondanks kritiek: 'Ik ben volgende lijsttrekker van VVD'

en.title: Yesilgöz despite criticism: 'I am the next VVD lead candidate'
en.summary: VVD party leader Yesilgöz has confirmed she intends to lead the party in the next election, stating she is the logical choice despite growing internal criticism.

stories.title: Rusland gaat diesel leveren aan de VS en aan de wereld

en.title: Russia to supply diesel to US and the world
en.summary: Russia will immediately deliver 300,000 tons of diesel to American and world markets, with additional planned shipments of 500,000 tons in November and later deliveries of up to 3 million tons, contingent on refinery conditions.

stories.title: PSV overtuigt niet bij herstart eredivisie, maar wint wel van Heerenveen (2-0)

en.title: PSV unconvincing in Eredivisie restart but beats Heerenveen (2-0)
en.summary: PSV won 2-0 against Heerenveen in the Eredivisie restart despite an unconvincing performance.

stories.title: Trump zegt dat Rusland per direct diesel aan VS gaat leveren, Oekraïne woedend

en.title: Trump says Russia to immediately deliver diesel to US, Ukraine furious
en.summary: US President Trump announced that Russia will supply 300,000 tons of diesel to the United States immediately, prompting strong anger from Ukraine.

stories.title: Nederland geeft diamant en zwaard terug aan Indonesië: ‘Ze hadden nooit in Nederland moeten zijn’

en.title: Netherlands returns diamond and sword to Indonesia: 'They should never have been in the Netherlands'
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning cultural artifacts including a diamond and sword to Indonesia, items that were improperly taken during the colonial period.

stories.title: Nederland geeft eeuwenoude koran en kostbare diamant terug aan Indonesië

en.title: Netherlands returns centuries-old Quran and valuable diamond to Indonesia
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning twenty cultural objects to Indonesia, including a 36-carat diamond, a handwritten Quran, and a traditional sword, all taken during the colonial era.

stories.title: Nederland geeft twintig gestolen voorwerpen terug aan Indonesië

en.title: Netherlands returns twenty stolen objects to Indonesia
en.summary: The Netherlands is returning twenty cultural objects to Indonesia that were taken during colonial times or obtained under coercion. Items include the Banjarmasin diamond, a handwritten Quran, and several gravestones, with most pieces coming from the Wereldmuseum and two from the Rijksmuseum.

stories.title: Fietsmerken Batavus, KOGA en Babboe blijven bestaan, verkocht aan Dutech

en.title: Bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe continue operations, sold to Dutech
en.summary: Dutch bicycle manufacturer Accell's brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe have been sold to Singapore-based investor Dutech following Accell's bankruptcy in August. The sale includes the company's IT platform and Hungarian operations, with potential for staff retention under new ownership.

stories.title: Fietsmerken Batavus, KOGA en Babboe vallen in Singaporese handen

en.title: Bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe fall into Singaporean hands
en.summary: Dutch bicycle manufacturers Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe have been sold to Singapore-based Dutech Holdings following the insolvency of their parent company Accell. The sale includes Accell's IT platform, Hungarian operations, and potentially part of its workforce.

stories.title: Dutch bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe to continue under new Singaporean owner

en.title: Dutch bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe to continue under new Singaporean owner
en.summary: The Dutch bicycle manufacturers Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe will resume operations under new ownership from Singapore.
